name: co.everypage/mcp
title: EveryPage
description: Share PDFs as tracked links and see who read them, how far they got, and where they stopped.

environmentVariables.name: EVERYPAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EveryPage API key (ep_live_...), created at https://everypage.co/account. An OAuth access token (ep_at_...) also works, limited to its granted scopes.

environmentVariables.name: EVERYPAGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin override, for self-hosted or development instances.

environmentVariables.name: EVERYPAGE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only the read-only tools (no upload, no changes, no deletion).
